integrity: Analytical proof uses global susceptible floor, exact pulse-continuous product, logistic comparison and Cesaro integration; included finite checker is corroboration, not an infinite-time certificate.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional unseasonal logistic-susceptible pulse-vaccination model at exact neutral invasion multiplier; all strictly positive initial conditions; not seasonal, stochastic, stage-structured or finite-time model. Exact amplitudes refer to n completed pulse periods.
title: Critical pulse vaccination: an exact Lyapunov product and phase-resolved epidemic clearance
